description:
⭐ Affiliate Hook Headline

Earn commission promoting premium clean-burning beeswax candles customers genuinely love — with higher rewards for top-performing partners.

• About our brand and products:

Bees Light Candles is a Pennsylvania-based small business specializing in clean-burning beeswax candles, candle-making supplies, and beautiful home décor. Every candle is hand-poured using responsibly sourced beeswax, with our yellow beeswax coming from local USA apiaries and our white beeswax sourced from North America. Our collections include pillars, tapers, tealights, floating candles, seasonal designs, and thoughtfully curated candle accessories for everyday living and gifting.

• What makes us different:

We focus on craftsmanship, sustainability, and quality. Unlike mass-produced paraffin candles, our beeswax candles burn cleanly, last longer, and provide a naturally warm glow customers love. Our brand has earned strong customer loyalty through thousands of positive reviews, reliable fulfillment, and a commitment to supporting pollinator awareness. Affiliates can confidently promote products that are handmade, trusted, and aligned with eco-friendly lifestyles.

• How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn commission on every qualifying order placed through their unique referral link. We provide competitive commission rates, seasonal promotions, and a growing catalog of high-quality products that encourage repeat purchases. High-performing affiliates may be rewarded with increased commission percentages and additional collaboration opportunities as their impact grows.

• How to promote us:

Affiliates can promote Bees Light Candles through social media posts, short-form video, home décor inspiration content, gifting guides, candle-making tutorials, blog features, email newsletters, and curated product recommendations. Our candles perform especially well in cozy lifestyle content, holiday promotions, seasonal décor inspiration, and eco-friendly living themes.

• Other information:

We are always happy to collaborate with motivated partners and creators who share our passion for quality handmade products. Affiliates may request additional product information, creative assets, or promotional support as needed. We regularly launch new designs and collections, giving affiliates fresh content and reasons to engage their audience.

We’re excited to grow alongside passionate partners who want to promote products that truly resonate with their audience. Join us today and start earning while helping more customers discover the warmth, quality, and craftsmanship of Bees Light Candles.
payout_period: Commissions are paid monthly between the 15th–20th for all approved orders from the previous month. Orders must pass the return period before payout.
